_readme: Reference paintings that become sprites (scripts/importSprites.mjs; see its header for every key). kind: building (default), prop (trees, bushes, mushrooms: anchor at the trunk base, scaled by targetHeight) or ground (a square texture folded onto the 32x16 diamond; family shares a palette). island picks an item of a sheet by row-major index (node scripts/importSprites.mjs --islands <src>). anchor: 'auto' (footprint), 'centre' (a sprite narrower than its footprint), or {ax, ay} hand-set; shift {x, y} moves the auto or centre anchor (y: 6 stands a small object in the middle of its tile instead of at its front corner; iteration 78). checked: true once the --check sheet has been judged by eye. flip: true mirrors a painting left to right, so its front sits on the right face like the procedural set's (iteration 56). A building's targetHeight is its procedural twin's height × 1.15 (towers × 1.3), with the centre anchor (iteration 56). kind 'vehicle' (the donkey carts, iteration 57): scale is a fraction of the painting's pixels, set per sheet so every donkey stands the same height; the cart faces right after any flip; mirrored: true also writes <name>_l, the left-facing twin.
